scenarios.scenario: Switch adjacent ribbon tabs with the mouse wheel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user scrolls down over the Tools tab
Manage becomes the active tab
the full Manage command groups are visible
the user scrolls up over the same position on the tab row
Tools becomes the active tab
the full Tools command groups are visible
the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Stop wheel navigation at the visible ends of the part ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full ribbon visible
the 3D Model tab is the first visible command tab and is active
the user scrolls up over the 3D Model tab
the 3D Model tab remains active
its command groups remain visible
the user selects the last visible command tab
the user scrolls down over the last visible command tab
the last visible command tab remains active
its command groups remain visible
the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Switch tabs with the mouse wheel in tabs-only display

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
Tools is the active tab in tabs-only ribbon display
no temporary ribbon commands are open
the user scrolls down over the Tools tab
Manage becomes the active tab
the ribbon remains in tabs-only display without opening temporary commands
the user scrolls up over the same position on the tab row
Tools becomes the active tab
the ribbon remains in tabs-only display without opening temporary commands
the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Switch an open temporary ribbon with the mouse wheel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
Tools is the active tab in tabs-only ribbon display
the temporary Tools command groups are open
the user scrolls down over the Tools tab
Manage becomes the active tab
temporary Manage command groups replace the Tools command groups
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary command groups close
Manage remains active in tabs-only display

scenarios.scenario: Open a panel compacted by a narrow application window

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Manage ribbon displayed
the Insert panel displays its commands directly at the wider window size
the user narrows the application window until Insert becomes a compact panel button
the Manage tab remains active
the part remains visible
the user clicks the compact Insert panel button
a temporary Insert panel opens below the ribbon with its commands
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary panel closes and the compact Insert button remains visible
the user maximizes the application window
the Insert commands appear directly in the ribbon again
the part remains visible
